primaryCTA: 4-step wizard: category/title/desc -> location (map pin + GPS) -> evidence photo upload -> review & submit

issuesFound: P1 broken contract: check-duplicate used mismatched query param names (latitude/longitude vs lat/lon) and mismatched response field names (hasPossibleDuplicate/nearbyCase vs hasDuplicate/possibleDuplicates) - the duplicate-warning modal never fired for any user, ever.
Draft auto-save (localStorage) was not owner-scoped - a draft typed by one logged-in user could be silently loaded into the form for a different user who later logs in on the same browser/device.
fixesApplied: reports.routes.ts GET /check-duplicate now accepts both param-name variants and returns both field-name variants. Verified end-to-end via curl AND via agent-browser (modal now visibly renders with real nearby-case data at the same coordinates known to have duplicates).

draftStorage.ts loadDraft() now takes an optional currentOwner and refuses to return a draft saved by a different owner; CreateReportPage now passes user?.id (or 'guest') as both the save-time owner and the load-time currentOwner.

primaryCTA: Link to related case if verified
issuesFound: Was reachable for ANY report id regardless of visibility (P1 privacy) - see endpoint fix
fixesApplied: Now returns 403 FORBIDDEN for a community/private report viewed by someone who isn't the owner/moderator/admin. Verified via curl with 3 identities (owner=200, moderator=200, other citizen=403, anonymous=403).

issuesFound: P0: page read `res.case` from the GET /cases/:id response, but the backend returns the case object at the TOP LEVEL of `data` with no `case` wrapper. Result: caseData was always undefined and the page unconditionally rendered 'Không tìm thấy vụ việc' for every case, for every role - confirmed live via agent-browser before the fix. This is the single most-linked page in the whole app (every 'Chi tiết' button across Dashboard/Map/Reports/Community/Notifications routes here), so this was effectively a full outage of case browsing.
fixesApplied: CaseDetailPage.tsx now reads `res.case || res` (and similarly unwraps confirmationCount/isConfirmedByMe/isSavedByMe with the real field names returned by CaseRepository.findById). Verified live via agent-browser: page now renders full case content, map, timeline (6 entries), and feedback section for the same case id that previously 404'd.

issuesFound: P0 silent failure: the photo-upload call hit a route that did not exist on the backend (404), and the failure was swallowed by a bare .catch(console.warn) - the citizen was told 'Đã ghi nhận quan sát hiện trường của bạn thành công!' while every attached evidence photo was silently discarded.
fixesApplied: Added POST /api/cases/:id/observations/:obsId/media to cases.routes.ts (multer upload + ObservationRepository.addMedia, mirroring the existing report-media upload pattern). Verified end-to-end with a real multipart PNG upload: row landed in observation_media with correct sha256, path, and survived a fresh DB re-query after the request completed.

fixesApplied: Added a same-status short-circuit in moderator.routes.ts. Verified by firing 2 concurrent forward requests at a fresh test case: exactly 1 case_updates row, 1 notification, 1 case row (reproduced 2/2/1 before the fix, confirmed 1/1/1 after).

issuesFound: content_reports table is permanently empty - there is no UI anywhere in the app that lets a citizen flag a post/comment, so this working queue+action mechanism has no real data to ever act on. The queue and its actions are correctly wired to the DB (verified by reading the code), but cannot be exercised end-to-end with real data because the upstream 'report this content' feature was never built.

P1 security: role/status change responses leaked the target user's bcrypt password_hash to the admin's browser
